item.title: Rachel Reeves spotted checking down the back of every government sofa ahead of Spring Statement
item.description: With minutes days to go before delivering her Spring Statement, Chancellor Rachel Reeves has reportedly been spotted rummaging behind every government sofa in a desperate hunt for spare change, long-forgotten valuables, or perhaps a magic cheque marked “From Gordon Brown — for emergencies.”

item.title: Pete Hegseth apologises for love-bite on Donald Trump’s neck
item.description: Despite the White House claiming a rash on Donald Trump’s neck was caused by a ‘preventative skin treatment’, it has now been revealed the red mark is actually a love-bite from Secretary of War Pete Hegseth.

item.title: Keir Starmer pictured with cigar and Homburg hat
item.description: Keir Starmer has been pictured with a huge cigar and Homburg hat after Donald Trump compared him unfavourably to Winston Churchill.

item.title: Cyclist repeatedly fails Captcha test after failing to identify images with traffic lights
item.description: Local cyclist Simon Williams has failed to access his favourite website this morning after it asked him to identify which images of a street contained traffic lights.

item.title: God issues urgent recall on ‘humanity’
item.description: The human race is facing being returned to its maker after a spokes-entity for God confirmed that He is to take out a full-page ad in many of the world's newspapers tomorrow asking for all humankind to be recalled to his factories.

item.title: Saharan dust storm and ‘blood rain’ could present best excuse for a sickie in years, insist experts
item.description: The Saharan dust cloud heading towards Britain could overtake 'dicky tummy' as the nation’s favourite excuse to phone in sick.

item.title: Man who attacked Iran, bombed Venezuela, uses military on own people and threatened to invade Greenland still wants Nobel Peace Prize
item.description: A man who recently attacked Iran, bombed Venezuela to capture its president, suggested using the military against his own citizens, and still occasionally threatens to invade Greenland has today confirmed he is absolutely baffled that he has not yet been awarded the Nobel Peace Prize.

item.title: Woman wondering if she ‘might’ own too many cushions
item.description: Homeowner Sharon Williams has today begun to wonder if the impossible has finally happened, and she now finds herself owning too many cushions.

item.title: Man left paralysed after being crushed under the weight of single perfectly manageable task
item.description: A man has been left utterly paralysed after being crushed under the immense weight of the single perfectly manageable task he has ahead of him today.

item.title: Paramount to remake Sinners with all-white cast
item.description: Following their proposed acquisition of Warner Bros., Paramount Skydance has announced they’re remaking Sinners with an all-white cast.
